rounds.reasoning_summary:
**My Thought Process on Addressing the Duplicate Email Issue**

Okay, so the user has pinpointed the root cause: a conflict between the Google Calendar integration and our app's reminder system, resulting in duplicate emails. They want to keep the integration, but they want one email not two.

The most straightforward solution, considering they want to keep the calendar sync, would be to advise them to disable the default email notifications specifically for the synced calendar within Google Calendar settings. This way, the user can let the app manage the alerts while keeping Google synced. I will suggest they go into Google Calendar, access "Settings" > "Settings for my calendars" > \[Your Synced Calendar] and remove the alerts.

Of course, they could also disable the reminder setting on the recurring task within our app, but from what I've seen, most users prefer to centralize reminder management within the app. I will include this as an option. The final response will give them a choice with clear instructions and a friendly offer for more support if needed.
rounds.response: Ah, great catch—that overlapping Google Calendar sync explains perfectly why those duplicate emails were showing up! Since you want to keep the integration active, the easiest solution is to turn off the default email notifications for this specific synced calendar directly within your Google Calendar settings. You can do this in Google Calendar by going to Settings, clicking on the synced calendar under "Settings for my calendars," and removing the alerts under the "Event notifications" section. Alternatively, you could just remove the reminder setting from the task in our app and let Google handle the alerts, depending on which platform you prefer managing notifications from. Give whichever method works best for your workflow a try, and please feel free to reach out if you have any more questions!
